name: Spider-Man (Classic)

abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Decelerate: Unstoppable ve Kaçış (Evade) yetenek doğruluğunu sabit bir miktarda azaltır.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Spider-sense
Increased agility coupled with a sixth sense for imminent danger grants a [7 - 28]% chance to Evade attacks. This does not trigger while Blocking, unless the attack is Unblockable.
The duration of Spider-Man's personal Taunts is increased by [0.1 - 4] seconds.
The potency of Spider-Man's personal Taunts is increased by [0.05 - 2]% flat.
4+ Webbing: The Debuffs from Webbing can stack up to 2 times.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Spider-Man's Basic Attacks have a 25% chance to inflict a Taunt Debuff for 7 seconds, reducing their Attack Rating by 1%. This chance increases by a flat 75% against Stunned Opponents.
Spider-Man has a 2% chance to Evade attacks for each Taunt effect on the Opponent. This does not trigger while Blocking, unless the attack is Unblockable.
The duration of Stun Debuffs on non-Skill Opponents cannot be reduced, and while the Opponent is Stunned their Ability Power Rate is reduced by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Webbing
content: Spider-Man uses his Special Attacks to web up his Opponent. As more Webbing is applied, the Opponent suffers various non-stacking Debuffs. Webbing falls off slowly as the Opponent attacks and moves.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each web-shooter attack applies 1 stack of Webbing to the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack inflicts a Stun Debuff on the Opponent for 3 seconds.
While this Stun is active, the Opponent's Physical Resistance is lowered by [1,178.57] for each Taunt on them.
